args.sql: SELECT CAST(event_time AS DATE) d, SUM(price) rev, COUNT(*) n FROM lh.ecommerce.events WHERE event_type='purchase' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT user_session FROM lh.ecommerce.events GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0) SELECT e.brand, SUM(e.price) lost, COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_session) sess FROM lh.ecommerce.events e JOIN s USING(user_session) WHERE e.event_type='cart' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
